title: Volvo FH 6 post High Tensile Alloy FUPS Bullbar #27
description: FH series Volvo heavy duty 6 post radar compatible FUPS hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar. Features 160mm deep skirt and 76mm heavy duty wall tube plus 1 set of Roo Slicers. LED combination indicator/daylight running lights in outer uprights. Optional spotlight mounts as requires. High tensile aluminium backing plate.
